text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Gold City talking with
Chairwoman Akikawa in the main courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Please! I'm counting on you!
I apologize for the sudden notice, but we need to meet the deadline...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Understood. Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"They're about to take photos
for the new student welcome brochure.
I'm subbing in as the photo model."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Phone
text_block_list.text:
"Uuu... I'm so sorry...! *sniff*
Why did I have to go and catch a cold...?!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah, please don't cry!
Anyone can catch a cold—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. Could I borrow that phone?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't cry anymore. I've already decided
that I'm going to take your place."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Line
text_block_list.text:
"*Sniff*... I'm so sorry...
I caused trouble for you too, City-san..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, that's not it, is it?
What you should be doing right now isn't apologizing, it's getting over that cold!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"So eat something nutritious and get to bed already!
That's all from me, got it?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Line
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mm, well done. With an enthusiastic response like that,
new jobs should start rolling in right away.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get started over here too.
We're using your racing outfits in addition to school uniforms, right?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Let's start with shots of the morning commute, please!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Next, inside the school building!
Very nice, that's a great expression!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Now let's take some in your racing outfit! Oh, looking cool!
One more shot, please!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright. The last one is a shot of her running, huh.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... As expected of an active model.
It's like she instinctively knows what kind of shot is wanted...

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Man, you look seriously cool. The shoot's going
so fast we might wrap up an hour early.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as the staff said, Gold City during the shoot was the very picture of a professional.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Different from her usual self on the track, she seemed dazzling and entirely out of reach—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Now for the last cut! City-san,
show us your absolute best weapon!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...My greatest weapon...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Got a second?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yep. You. What do you think
my greatest weapon is?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, so that's what you thought.
About my running?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha... Thanks for the overly passionate answer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's wild.
Me, getting down and "gritty"?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. You're the only one
who'd say something like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gold City headed into
her final photoshoot, and—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Good work out there~

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Man, as expected. That final run
and pose really brought out her unique style~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just as the staff said, she was flawless
throughout the entire shoot. If so, then why..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ? What is it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Why did you ask me what your greatest weapon is?
Why did you ask me what your greatest weapon was?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Back then, even without going out of her way to ask me,
she probably already understood, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Look. A model's whole job is to
deliver on whatever the client asks for.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I just asked.
Asked the person who understands 'my greatest weapon'
even better than I do."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You're my Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bathed in the glow of the sunset, her expression was no longer that of a model, but that of a Tracen Academy student.
